name: @beings/verifier
description: B.E.I.N.G.S. Verifier node (M6): beings-verify-images (signed bulk download of ballot images, checked against the ledger), beings-blind-reread (masked, independent re-read of every ballot image compared with the on-chain results) and beings-consensus (three-threshold Merkle check of fill scores already computed). The rest of M6 is not yet implemented.
